title: viola mandshurica f. macrantha
intro: Viola mandshurica f. macrantha, commonly known as Korean violet or purple violet, is a type of flowering plant in the violet family (Violaceae). It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Viola mandshurica f. macrantha include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
